role: Graduate Engineer - next Graduate Development Program intake (Civil stream)
subject: Expression of interest: next Graduate Development Program (Civil), Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello People and Culture team,

This is a speculative enquiry about Decmil's next Graduate Development Program intake in the Graduate Engineer (Civil) stream. I know the prior cohort is already under way, so I am not treating this as an open advertised vacancy.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026 with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD, after a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering. From 2019 to 2020 I worked in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge on building renovation and subdivision finishing works. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and FIFO work and would prefer a Victoria placement if available.

Your program's hands-on civil stream into site engineer pathways is the path I am aiming for. I have not yet worked on Australian major projects, so Decmil mentoring would be essential.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. If useful, please advise when the next intake opens or the right portal to register.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio

subject: Application: Graduate Engineer, Brisbane, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hello Diona hiring team,

I am applying for the Graduate Engineer role in Brisbane advertised on your LiveHire careers page.

I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026 (road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in Civil 3D and AutoCAD) after a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering. From 2019 to 2020 I worked in the Philippines as a field engineer and project-in-charge on a community hall renovation and subdivision finishing works, coordinating crews, inspections and site records. I am based in Melton VIC, hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and have full working rights to December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am available for site, regional and interstate project work.

Your Brisbane graduate role on utility civil construction, including pipelines, drainage and concrete works, matches the kind of hands-on project delivery I want to learn properly. I have not yet worked on Australian water, sewer or gas pipeline projects, so I would treat that as a learning curve under your team.

I've attached my resume and cover letter. Happy to complete the LiveHire application steps or any further screening you need.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
